system: You are the onboarding assistant at Tallyfield, a dispatch software company. An onboarding manager is asking about one client. Start your reply with one line 'Answer: <at most eight words>', then at most two sentences.

sso.label: sign-in
sso.say: Which identity provider should {name}'s staff sign in with?

region.label: data region
region.say: Which data region should {name}'s workspace be created in?

import.label: import format
import.say: What file format should {name} send for the shipment import?

training.label: training slot
training.say: What day and time should we book {name}'s dispatcher training?

facts.text: Northwind Freight signs in with Okta; they have no Azure AD (Entra ID) tenant.
Northwind Freight's contract requires all of their data to stay in the EU, in the Frankfurt (eu-central-1) region.
Northwind Freight can only export shipments from their ERP as XML; they cannot produce CSV files.
Northwind Freight's dispatchers work night shifts, so their training must start after 18:00 Hamburg time.
Copperline Couriers' parent company requires their workspace in us-west-2 (Oregon), next to its other systems.
Copperline Couriers sends shipments through the Tallyfield REST API as JSON; they have no file export.
Lakemont Grocers is on the Starter plan, which has no SSO; their staff sign in with email, password and two-factor codes.
Lakemont Grocers' dispatchers can only train on Saturdays at 08:00, before the store deliveries start.

week1.label: Week 1
notes: SSO setup: in Azure AD (Entra ID), register Tallyfield as an enterprise application.
SSO setup: copy the Tallyfield ACS URL into the Azure AD SAML configuration.
SSO setup: map the Azure AD 'mail' claim to the Tallyfield email attribute.
Data region: new Tallyfield workspaces are created in us-east-1 by default.
Data region: the region of a workspace cannot be changed after it is created.
Data region: available regions are us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-central-1 and ap-southeast-1.
Shipment import: clients send shipments as a CSV file with one row per shipment.
Shipment import: the CSV must have the columns shipment_id, origin, destination, weight_kg, pickup_date.
Shipment import: CSV files must be UTF-8 encoded with a header row.
Dispatcher training: standard sessions run on Tuesdays at 10:00 client local time.
Dispatcher training: each session lasts 90 minutes and covers route planning and exceptions.
Dispatcher training: book the session two weeks ahead through the onboarding calendar.

month12.label: Month 12
notes: SSO setup: in Azure AD (Entra ID), register Tallyfield as an enterprise application.
SSO setup: copy the Tallyfield ACS URL into the Azure AD SAML configuration.
SSO setup: map the Azure AD 'mail' claim to the Tallyfield email attribute.
SSO setup: assign the client's Azure AD security group to the Tallyfield app.
SSO setup: test SSO with one Azure AD account before enforcing it for everyone.
SSO setup: Tallyfield supports SAML 2.0 single sign-on.
SSO setup: enforce SSO only after the client's admin confirms a successful test login.
SSO setup: the client's IT admin needs Global Administrator rights in Azure AD.
Data region: new Tallyfield workspaces are created in us-east-1 by default.
Data region: the region of a workspace cannot be changed after it is created.
Data region: available regions are us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-central-1 and ap-southeast-1.
Data region: most clients run in us-east-1.
Data region: backups are stored in the same region as the workspace.
Data region: the onboarding manager picks the region when creating the workspace.
Data region: us-east-1 gets new Tallyfield features first.
Shipment import: clients send shipments as a CSV file with one row per shipment.
Shipment import: the CSV must have the columns shipment_id, origin, destination, weight_kg, pickup_date.
Shipment import: CSV files must be UTF-8 encoded with a header row.
Shipment import: the maximum CSV file size is 50 MB; split larger exports.
Shipment import: dates in the CSV use the format YYYY-MM-DD.
Shipment import: upload the CSV under Settings > Data > Import shipments.
Shipment import: run a 100-row sample CSV first to check the column mapping.
Dispatcher training: standard sessions run on Tuesdays at 10:00 client local time.
Dispatcher training: each session lasts 90 minutes and covers route planning and exceptions.
Dispatcher training: book the session two weeks ahead through the onboarding calendar.
Dispatcher training: sessions run in the morning so dispatchers can practise during the day shift.
Dispatcher training: up to 12 dispatchers can join one session.
Dispatcher training: send the training checklist to the client's team lead the day before.
Dispatcher training: schedule training after the shipment import is complete.
